scope: Educational hardware appearance and light-direction explanation only; not scientific SPHEREx pixels or calibrated ray tracing

images.used_for: Primary segment seams, gold/silver contrast, blankets and supports
Open aperture door, reflective insulation, source-era historical array appearance
Qualitative open-tube -> primary -> secondary -> primary opening -> instruments order
Primary -> secondary -> aft tertiary/fine steering -> instruments; our SVG is original and schematic

geometry_method: Hash-pinned official NASA GLBs. Webb A full world transforms baked before batching; 493785 triangles retained, 1657 render meshes -> 54. Sequential Draco quantizes positions/normals. Naive CLI join/flatten was rejected after independent decoded-bounds checks exposed changed shape; EdgeBreaker discarded 801 source triangles. Neither rejected derivative ships.

preparation_dependencies.runtime_requirement: None: development asset preparation only. Existing local Three.js loader/Draco decoder serves the derivative offline.

appearance_method: Source-informed estimated PBR values; Hubble preserves source UVs and five colour atlases and derives bounded metal/roughness masks. Webb retains source hardware geometry with gold primary, silver/pink shields, insulation and low-metalness solar/black surfaces. Original procedural foil normal field applied only where source UVs exist. Virtual studio reflection cards are presentation lighting, not a physical Sun/environment.
hubble_aperture: 96 pinned source-cover triangles reposed around an inferred hinge into an illustrative open state. Added dark recess and rim are appearance only. No hidden internal optical surfaces reconstructed; exact door angle and baffle dimensions are inferred. Nine geometry-intersection samples pass into the tube. Original GLB bytes unchanged.
axes: Detailed Webb A +X toward its source secondary, rotated -pi/2 around scene Y; lightweight NASA B +Z; Hubble front +Y. SPHEREx frame matches existing inferred 0.1-radian Z housing tilt and full root transform. Model geometry alignment only, no measured flight boresight.
external_paths: Eight parallel on-axis samples toward a model-local collecting plane, transformed with the full model matrix. Segment lengths/speed are illustrative. Foreground-mesh intersection stops markers on support structures; this visibility test performs no optical reflections/refractions. Colour keys change tint only. No FOV cone, pre-aperture convergence, coloured prism fan or 3D published-image billboard.
internal_paths: Original four-step SVG diagrams independently explain the optical order. Schematics are not to scale; SPHEREx mirror geometry remains explicitly unreconstructed. Published mission images retain source-verified native pixels and separate 2D credit panels, not live/matched targets.
limits: Material reflectance/roughness and fine normals are appearance estimates, not measured BRDF
Hubble source-era hardware retained; no claim of exact present-day flight configuration
No engineering CAD, optical prescription, PSF, throughput, field angles, telemetry or live pointing certification
Reference photographs are not baked into model textures; no NASA Eyes assets extracted
Qualified scientific approval and internal human review PENDING
